name: workadventure
title_zh: 在 WorkAdventure 里替你认路、搭话
tagline_zh: 不用再拖着小人满场找同事——一句「跟着他」就自动尾随，一句「打个招呼」就弹出气泡。开会迟到也能一键瞬移到角落。
tagline_en: Stop dragging your avatar across the map. Say 'follow him' and it tails; 'say hi' and it bubbles. Late? Teleport.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to do something with their WorkAdventure avatar / "in the room" / "in workadventure" — join or leave, see who's around, walk to or follow a player, greet someone, show a speech or thought bubble, or go sit somewhere quiet.
why_zh: 把地图坐标、玩家状态和气泡指令封装成自然语言动作，省去手动点击和键盘导航。
why_en: Wraps map coordinates, player states, and bubble commands into natural-language actions—so virtual-office socializing feels like.
limit_zh: 仅限 WorkAdventure 网页端，需已登录且角色在房间内；不能操控非玩家角色，不能读取聊天记录。
limit_en: WorkAdventure web only, logged-in & in-room. No NPC control, no chat log access, movement bounded by map walls.
title_en: Your avatar's eyes and hands inside WorkAdventure
